question: Should OpenClaw accept this Vault SecretRef resolver as a bundled core plugin, or keep Vault as an external ClawHub/plugin distribution on the existing SecretRef integration seam?
rationale: The implementation uses the right pluginIntegration seam and has real proof, but VISION.md sets a high bar for optional bundled plugins and CODEOWNERS routes the touched secrets/lockfile surface to secops.

options.title: Approve bundled Vault after secops review
options.body: Accept the bundled reference only after secops/product approve the exec resolver trust boundary and the contributor aligns package metadata before merge.

options.title: Keep Vault external
options.body: Close or redirect this PR and publish the Vault integration through ClawHub or an official external plugin package instead of core.

options.title: Defer the bundling decision
options.body: Hold the PR until maintainers define when vendor SecretRef providers graduate from external plugin to bundled core package.

recommendation.title: Approve bundled Vault after secops review
recommendation.body: Accept the bundled reference only after secops/product approve the exec resolver trust boundary and the contributor aligns package metadata before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved decision is centered on credentials, exec resolver behavior, lockfile/package review, and secrets docs, all of which CODEOWNERS routes to secops.
